To re-develop behavior one had previously grown out of, particularly a behavior left behind in childhood.

examples.text: Your nightmares stopped when you were eight years old, but after the house burned down, you regressed.

glosses: To move in the retrograde direction.
To reduce in severity or size (as of a tumor), without reaching total remission.
To perform a regression on an explanatory variable.

examples.text: When we regress Y on X, we use the values of variable X to predict those of Y.

glosses: To interrogate a person in a state of trance about forgotten elements of their past.

examples.text: They regressed me, putting me under hypnosis. Then, through the hypnosis, they found out that our car was abducted right off the road and into a craft.
